purpose: Fill the official Qwen3.8 FP8 TP2 target-only context gap with exact measured decode and TTFT points, plus a disclosed effective-prompt-throughput proxy.

tuple.quantization: official block-scaled FP8 target weights; FP16 KV
tuple.generation: target-only / MTP0 / no draft / no speculation
tuple.graph: PIECEWISE decode capture size one; experimental TP2 XPU graph

metrics.decode: 99 inter-token intervals between streamed token-ID events 1 and 100 after TTFT
metrics.ttft: HTTP request start to first returned token
metrics.effective_prompt_throughput_proxy: exact submitted prompt tokens divided by measured TTFT seconds; includes HTTP scheduling, chunked prefill, and first-token work and is not a server-only kernel prefill rate
metrics.workload_grade: C repeated-token exact-shape fixture; not natural prose

required_gates: clean pushed main and exclusive host/GPU locks before launch
exact pinned image is local and ordinary plus O_DIRECT model identities match
fixture, client, verifier, model manifest, and preregistration hashes are captured
all six receipts report exact prompt usage, 128 completion token IDs, cache zero, no truncation, and no context shift
container stops cleanly and both render nodes are idle after the run

failure_policy.startup_or_capacity_failure: preserve logs and publish no cells; any changed memory, batch, context, or graph setting requires a new preregistration

publication.zero_context_point: not measured and must remain absent
publication.headline_effect: additive operating profile only; does not replace the 4K featured decode result
